description: AI Stupid Level's current picks: the best model for coding, the most reliable (steadiest score), the fastest, the best value (most points per measured dollar among near-top models), models that cost far more than an equally good alternative, and models to avoid right now. period.description: Score window: 24h, 7d or 1m (30-day) averages, or latest (the newest run). Omit it to use the key's default: 24h on a free Data API key, latest on a paid one. latest needs a paid key.
